notes.manas-2010:p0056:b002:l005: абийир may denote honor or the private parts; exposed shame is provisional, retaining the cover/exposure image.
notes.manas-2010:p0056:b002:l012: эл аккан is visibly present but syntactically uncertain; flowing spring of our people is a literal provisional reading, not a correction to элге or another reading.
notes.manas-2010:p0056:b002:l021: Керүүгө is uncertain; on the slope is provisional. Tree/bak imagery retained rather than replaced by an inferred house or garden.
notes.manas-2010:p0058:b002:l004: Шамыянын rendered plow beam from the immediate agricultural context; exact implement term unresolved. Direct dictionary URL failed; no successful lexical verification claimed.
notes.manas-2010:p0058:b002:l019: Санаасы менен болтуруп is awkward in the witness; bringing their wishes to fulfillment is contextual, provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0058:b002:l030: сан retained as san, an epic multitude unit; six retained without inventing an exact number of camels.
notes.manas-2010:p0058:b002:l036: Six san retained, without exact-number expansion.
notes.manas-2010:p0059:b002:l024: Nine san retained, without exact-number expansion.
notes.manas-2010:p0059:b002:l025: Visible алам жок literally suggests no dappled one; retained provisionally although the immediate lament suggests possible defective text. Тобурчак and тулпар both denote fine horses; no emendation to балам жок has been made.
notes.manas-2010:p0059:b002:l029: мээси жок literally without brains/sense, retained; not silently emended to ээси жок (without an owner).
notes.manas-2010:p0059:b002:l039: Six san retained, without exact-number expansion.
notes.manas-2010:p0059:b002:l045: Турага may refer to a dwelling/settlement; dwelling is provisional in the livestock context.
notes.manas-2010:p0060:b002:l003: Солбуп is visibly present and uncertain; let down is provisional in the hair-combing phrase.
notes.manas-2010:p0060:b002:l010: The extractor gives Ээ as its own segment, but the rendered PDF places Ээ and мураска жетемин on one display baseline with a wide gap. Both IDs retained separately under provisional lineation. Ah treats Ээ as interjection; noun owner is also possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0060:b002:l011: Visible declarative жетемин retained, though the surrounding rhetorical questions may indicate a defective reading. See previous source ID for shared visual baseline.
notes.manas-2010:p0060:b002:l014: мээси жок literally without brains/sense retained, not silently emended to ээси жок.
notes.manas-2010:p0060:b002:l018: Subject/object implicit; English supplies a child from the following infant-cry line. Literal wording is I did not go/lead walking to the place of honor; interpretation remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0060:b002:l021: The claim of no steed contrasts with the abundant horses earlier; retained without harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0061:b002:l006: кочку means Kalmyk village headman in Yudakhin; rendered by title, not butcher. It also appears as a character name in the epic. https://el-sozduk.kg/кочку/
notes.manas-2010:p0061:b002:l013: The visible Балтай resembles Baltay the person, but hawthorn haft and fitting in the next line suggest балта (axe), perhaps wordplay or defective text. English retains Baltay and the axe image; not silently corrected in source.
notes.manas-2010:p0061:b002:l017: Same Baltay/balta ambiguity as p61:l013; black-cheeked is an axe epithet, retained beside the visible name.
notes.manas-2010:p0061:b002:l048: кекерди visibly present; troubles is a contextual rendering, exact reading unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0062:b002:l027: туркана retained as Turkana; ethnonym or descriptive expression unresolved. No modern ethnic identification asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0062:b002:l029: дуңкана interpreted as Dungans; source form retained unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0062:b002:l030: Бээлесең: Yudakhin identifies бээле- with бейле-, pay attention/consider closely (https://el-sozduk.kg/бээ/; https://el-sozduk.kg/бей/). Revised from the unsupported contextual tell of them after re-viewing page 62 and checking the surrounding account of peoples in Beijing. This supplies the implicit object; бейарман remains without regret.
notes.manas-2010:p0062:b002:l033: Салалык retained as Salalyk; possible relationship to Salar is not silently substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0062:b002:l047: кулач rendered fathoms as arm-span units, not certified English imperial fathoms. Ninety thousand preserved exactly.
notes.manas-2010:p0063:b002:l014: Илийи retained as Iliyi, apparently qualifying/naming a divination book; exact reading and identification unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0063:b002:l034: себилдүү means armed/equipped in Yudakhin and the 1969/2015 explanatory dictionaries. Eighty-four are fully armed preserves the number and leaves the referent implicit; not confidently identified as weapons or companions. https://el-sozduk.kg/себил/
notes.manas-2010:p0064:b002:l015: кылым rendered peoples here, consistent with the epic collective/world sense, not twelve literal centuries; exact scope uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0064:b002:l017: Укурук кайрар is obscure; draft retains horse-catching pole and turning image. Its formulaic implication is total destruction; precise literal construction unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0064:b002:l020: Repeated Укурук кайрар line retained; same uncertainty as p64:l017.
notes.manas-2010:p0064:b002:l027: Кызыталак is a harsh abuse, rendered bastard functionally, without asserting literal illegitimacy; көк жал wolf/hero epithet retained as fierce wolf.
notes.manas-2010:p0064:b002:l034: кожо сан may mean a host of khojas, or a defective form/name such as Khojasan; draft retains host of khojas provisionally. No identification as a particular saint asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0064:b002:l035: чилтен retained as chilten, supernatural saintly protectors in epic tradition; forty retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0064:b002:l040: Lexical correction: таш сайынган means a Chinese/Kalmyk official wearing a distinguishing ball/button on the cap, Yudakhin таш I.5 https://el-sozduk.kg/таш/. In this formula таза means finest, not bald/shaven: Yudakhin таза3 https://el-sozduk.kg/ТАЗ/. Raw source unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0064:b002:l041: тазасын interpreted as the finest/choicest in the officials context, rather than complete extermination; exact nuance provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0065:b002:l002: Salt/food phrase is retained despite uncertain connection with the preceding bitterness line; no missing clause invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0065:b002:l012: Lexical correction: таш сайынган means a Chinese/Kalmyk official wearing a distinguishing ball/button on the cap, Yudakhin таш I.5 https://el-sozduk.kg/таш/. In this formula таза means finest, not bald/shaven: Yudakhin таза3 https://el-sozduk.kg/ТАЗ/. Raw source unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0065:b002:l032: умачтай is a food-based simile; crumbled dough retained. The idiom means thoroughly dispelling sleep; exact image uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0066:b002:l001: боотай retained as bootay, apparently a written divinatory record in this context; exact reading unresolved, direct dictionary URL failed.
notes.manas-2010:p0066:b002:l013: боконо denotes short ribs in the explanatory dictionary (Yudakhin: false ribs); the phrase expresses shuddering/emotional weakening. https://el-sozduk.kg/бокон/
notes.manas-2010:p0066:b002:l018: саат I denotes hindrance/trouble, and сааты бар a troublesome person in Yudakhin; troubles preferred without conjectural armor emendation. Exact syntax of Угулуп мынча remains provisional. https://el-sozduk.kg/саат/
notes.manas-2010:p0066:b002:l032: Аган interpreted contextually as ага (him); visible Аган retained in Kyrgyz.
notes.manas-2010:p0066:b002:l033: болжошу visibly present; companion provisionally interprets a likely жолдошу reading. Naked Kydyr retained; no silent source correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0066:b002:l038: көй кашка interpreted as distinguished champions; split phrase retained across the two extracted display segments.
notes.manas-2010:p0067:b002:l008: Hundred years retained. Whether subject is Esenkan or the following Karykan is syntactically ambiguous; English pronoun leaves subject unnamed.
notes.manas-2010:p0067:b002:l026: тоз rendered birch bark literally; dust/fire formula remains uncertain in this context.
notes.manas-2010:p0068:b002:l023: карапчы described as an ancient defensive implement in the 2015 explanatory dictionary; protective armor follows кийген, wearing. Exact armor type unspecified. https://el-sozduk.kg/карапчы/
notes.manas-2010:p0068:b002:l039: Has been born retained although the narrator later says Manas is not yet born; character report not harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p0069:b002:l004: Without leaving him alive retained, despite adjacent orders to bring him. Contradiction in the command is not silently resolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0069:b002:l014: коок retained as kook: punitive head covering, traditionally rawhide, documented in Yudakhin and explanatory dictionaries. Material is not specified in this verse. https://el-sozduk.kg/коок/
notes.manas-2010:p0069:b002:l018: Үшүнтүп сурайм жашыңды is visibly present but uncertain; question your age till you shudder is provisional and near literal.
notes.manas-2010:p0069:b002:l021: Дарыга interpreted contextually as дарга, to the gallows; source spelling preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0069:b002:l033: Protective armor for карапчы; see p68:l023. Billowing shape preserved; no specific armor construction asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0070:b002:l023: байдаңды interpreted as banner, related to байдак; exact visible form retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0070:b002:l043: Жадалдап чыккан көзүңдү is uncertain and grammatically incomplete; eyes bulging in haste is provisional; no unexpressed mutilation supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0071:b002:l022: Билге interpreted as белге, at the waist, from loading ammunition context; visible form retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0071:b002:l033: Токушкер retained as Tokushker, apparently a people/place in this list; identification unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0071:b002:l041: Атагын көргөн mixes seeing and renown; English retains both rather than correcting source to атын/атын уккан.
notes.manas-2010:p0072:b002:l009: сындан interpreted contextually as сандан, beyond counting; visible source retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0072:b002:l038: Сүрүнети interpreted as circumcision (сүннөт); visible witness spelling retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0073:b002:l004: ат бороюн сыдыруу is an idiom for traveling everywhere / long journeys wearing out horses, per 1969 and 2015 explanatory dictionaries; no literal withers injury asserted. https://el-sozduk.kg/борой/
notes.manas-2010:p0073:b002:l024: Anjyiyan transliterates visible Анжыян; not silently replaced with a standardized modern city spelling.
notes.manas-2010:p0073:b002:l025: Бузулган-Чамбыл retained as Ruined Chambyl, an epic place-name/descriptive compound, not independently geolocated.
notes.manas-2010:p0073:b002:l029: Аты казак колунда is syntactically uncertain; under the name of Kazakh is provisional; no army size inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0074:b002:l001: Арыкты literally irrigation ditch retained, although a damaged/variant reading in this turmoil formula is possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0074:b002:l016: кат койдук literally put in writing retained; possible defective ат койдук (named) not silently substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0074:b002:l018: Visible Жар Манас kept as Jar Manas, the other child; no equation with Jakyp’s still-unborn Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0074:b002:l047: кааласа can mean wanted/sought; sought is provisional in the examination scene.
notes.manas-2010:p0075:b002:l008: өзү тургай көзү literally more than himself, his eye, is an emphatic identification formula. Image retained rather than omitted; English idiom remains awkward.
notes.manas-2010:p0075:b002:l033: Repeated identification formula retained; see p75:l008.
notes.manas-2010:p0075:b002:l041: Өлүп кетер ой кылып literally thinking he would die retained; possibility of a defective conventional feast formula unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0075:b002:l043: Ок эки visibly present; twelve interprets likely Он эки, consistent with the numeral construction. Source not corrected silently.

prose_passages.classification: Prose scene-summary bridge; modern editorial versus narrated origin unverified; not published as folklore verse.
prose_passages.en: Then Jakyp said, “I have raised such countless livestock, yet I have no child. What will become of my life?” He gathered the forty Kyrgyz households and said, “Who will own these great forsaken herds?” He devised a plan no one could conceive and held a feast reaching the whole world. This is the scene where Jakyp asks the Creator for a child and stands weeping in sorrow.
